query: What objective calibration strategy (loss function, optimization method, constraints) should we use to tune MFs and rule weights using AIS and incident data?

response.query: What objective calibration strategy (loss function, optimization method, constraints) should we use to tune MFs and rule weights using AIS and incident data?
response.answer: Use a loss function like Mean Squared Error, optimization method like Gradient Descent, and constraints to ensure non-negativity for tuning membership functions and rule weights.

results.title: [PDF] European Network Operations Plan 2025/2026 - 2029 - Eurocontrol
results.content: 10.3 Network capacity enhancement measures • Additional actions o A coordinated approach between the Network Manager and the ANSPs to propose network solutions to minimise the impact of the bottleneck areas on the network o A partnership approach between the Network Manager and the operational stakeholders, and especially the ANSPs, to ensure the evaluation and revision of the individual local plans based on the suggestions made by the Network Manager o Reinforcement of the capacity planning processes, airspace design and utilisation, coordination of airport operations improvements, actions and activities at local and network level o Daily monitoring of operational performance indicators resulting in the identification of required local and network actions and measures (at pre-tactical and tactical level) to further enhance operational performance EUROCONTROL Network Management Directorate Edition Number: 1.0 Edition Validity Date: 29-04-2025 Classification: Green Page: 218 Page Validity Date: 26-02-2025 o Post operations reporting and analysis for feedback o Development and full implementation of the European Route Network Improvement Plan over the period 2024-2030 o Integrating airports into the network o Preparation of special events to mitigate impact on the network performance o Preparation of system changes to ensure minimum impact on the network o Identification of actions, including a repository of procedures, to mitigate industrial action impact o Development and implementation of new ATS procedures at network level aiming at increasing operational performance o The development of enhanced airspace management/flexible use of airspace processes and procedures must continue and must be applied both at local and network levels.
